lines.ob_hello: Namaste! Main Priya hoon, aapki memory coach. Roz sirf teen minute, aur aapki yaaddasht pehle se tez. Chaliye, shuru karte hain.
lines.ob_name: Pehle bataiye, main aapko kya bulaun?
lines.ob_forget: Sabse zyada kya bhool jaate hain aap?
lines.ob_age: Aur aapki age kitni hai? Isse main aapke liye sahi examples chunungi.
lines.ob_time: Din mein kab teen minute shanti se milte hain aapko? Us waqt main yaad dila dungi.
lines.ob_test_intro: Ab ek chhota sa test. Main chhe cheezein dikhaungi, pandrah second ke liye. Jitni yaad rahein, utni. Koi tension nahi.
lines.ob_test_go: Dekhiye. Yaad rakhne ki koshish kijiye.
lines.ob_recall: Ab bataiye. Kaun si cheezein thi? Jo yaad hain, un par tap kijiye.
lines.ob_result_lo: Theek hai. Yeh bilkul normal hai. Bina trick ke sab ka yahi haal hota hai. Ab dekhiye, trick ke baad kya hota hai.
lines.ob_result_mid: Achha! Aadhi se zyada yaad rahin. Ab dekhiye, trick ke baad kya hota hai.
lines.ob_result_hi: Wah! Aapki memory already achhi hai. Ab trick ke saath aur bhi tez hogi.
lines.home_today: Namaste! Aaj ka session tayyar hai. Sirf teen minute.
lines.home_done: Aaj ka kaam ho gaya. Shabash! Kal phir milenge.
lines.home_review: Ek minute ka review hai. Dekhte hain, purani list abhi bhi yaad hai ya nahi.
lines.review_intro: Yaad hai woh kahani? Doodh, aur phir? Jo cheezein yaad hain, un par tap kijiye.
lines.review_good: Shabash! Kahani abhi bhi dimaag mein hai. Yahi toh trick ki taakat hai.
lines.review_ok: Kuch yaad rahin, kuch nahi. Koi baat nahi. Kahani ek baar phir sun lijiye, aur pakki ho jayegi.
lines.remind_line: Namaste, main Priya hoon. Teen minute nikaliye. Dimaag ko bhi kasrat chahiye.
lines.fam_intro: Family ke saath muqabla kijiye. Ek code banaiye, WhatsApp par bhejiye, aur sab ek hi board par.
lines.progress_intro: Yeh raha aapka safar. Har din score thoda upar.
